cells.gaps: No rule held requires mobile money providers and banks to connect to each other or to a national or regional switch. The National Payment System Bill passed both houses by January 2026; its signing is not reported.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-12: the Mobile Money Regulations, Amended 2020, set out the licensing of mobile money service providers (SOM-003), a provider licensing regime, which message 35 makes a yes to question 3 without a source saying non-banks. No connection rule is held, so 4 and not 5.
